meta_description: Law Office of Mgr. Irena Mužíková in Prague. Specializing in family law, real estate law, commercial law, insolvency law, labor law and intellectual property law.

hero_title: Mgr. Irena Mužíková, Attorney at Law

about_description: Attorney with general practice focusing on family law, real estate law and commercial law.
sec_services_subtitle: Attorney with general practice focusing on family law, real estate law and commercial law
sec_services_g1_content: legal representation in divorce proceedings (contentious and non-contentious);legal representation in proceedings concerning the care of minor children (custody and child support), preparation of agreements;legal representation in proceedings concerning the division of community property (preparation of agreements on the division of community property);legal representation in proceedings concerning child support (for adult and minor children), spouse, divorced spouse
sec_services_g2_content: contracts for the transfer of real estate (purchase contracts, donation contracts);attorney escrow services;proposals for the registration of rights in the land registry, transfer of membership rights and obligations associated with membership in a housing cooperative;declaration of the building owner;pledge agreements;easement agreements;establishment of unit owners associations
sec_services_g3_content: establishment of business companies;collection of receivables from regular business transactions;consulting and preparation of comprehensive contractual documentation (purchase contracts and work contracts, loan agreements, contracts for the assignment of receivables, commercial representation contracts and similar);representation in negotiations with client's business partners and other legal entities;liquidation and dissolution of companies, including proceedings before the registry court;changes in the ownership structure of business companies - transfers of business shares, including changes in the commercial register;protection against unfair competition
sec_services_g4_content: preparation of insolvency petitions;representation of clients in insolvency proceedings, both on the side of the debtor and the creditor;representation of creditors in creditors' committees;representation in incidental disputes;consulting for companies threatened by insolvency
sec_services_g5_content: consulting for employers and employees;asserting claims from invalid termination of employment;preparation of labor law documents - employment contracts, contracts for the performance of the function of managing director, work regulations;consulting on the creation, change and termination of employment
ref_1_text: Mrs. Mužíková helped me through a difficult divorce. Her professional approach and human touch were amazing.
ref_2_text: Excellent service in commercial law. Quick action and effective solution to our problem.
ref_3_text: Professional approach to property transfer. Everything went smoothly and without complications.

aml_title: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Policy
aml_intro_text: The Law Office of Mgr. Irena Mužíková is obliged under Act No. 253/2008 Coll., on Certain Measures against the Legalization of Proceeds of Crime and Financing of Terrorism, as amended (hereinafter referred to as the 'AML Act'), to identify its clients and keep relevant records about them.
aml_id_text: In accordance with the AML Act, I am obliged to:
aml_id_1: Identify the client before providing legal services
aml_id_2: Determine the beneficial owner of the client (for legal entities)
aml_id_3: Continuously monitor the business relationship with the client
aml_id_4: Perform client checks against sanctions lists
aml_docs_text: Documents obtained during client identification are kept for the period specified by the AML Act, i.e., at least 10 years from the end of the business relationship or from the execution of a one-time transaction.
aml_report_text: In case of suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing, I am obliged to submit a notification to the Financial Analytical Unit of the Ministry of Finance of the Czech Republic.

sec_cooperation_text_1: Before providing legal services, we have an initial consultation about the client's situation by phone, email or during a short personal meeting. Based on the initial information, the client gains an overview of the options for further action and the exact conditions of legal services.
sec_cooperation_text_2: The provision of legal services is subject to an agreement on remuneration, which can be determined either as a lump sum, according to an hourly rate, according to the attorney tariff, or as a share of the result (success fee).
